QuestInfo.name: [World Tour] Ten Mini-games for an EXP Coupon
QuestInfo.0: Participate in the bull run from Spain, the city race from Singapore, and the pinball game from the United States. Travelers who clear any one of them 10 times get a 2x EXP Coupon!
